Disclosure to Promote the Right To Information 

Whereas the Parliament of India has set out to provide a practical regime of right to 
information for citizens to secure access to information under the control of public authorities, 
in order to promote transparency and accountability in the working of every public authority, 
and whereas the attached publication of the Bureau of Indian Standards is of particular interest 
to the public, particularly disadvantaged communities and those engaged in the pursuit of 
education and knowledge, the attached public safety standard is made available to promote the 
timely dissemination of this information in an accurate manner to the public.

1- Scope — Covers the dimensions for spindle noses for use with adjustable adaptors of short, 
long and extra long types according to IS : 8919 ( Part I )-1978 ■ Specification for adjustable adaptors 
for tools with self-holding taper shanks: Part I Short adaptors \ IS : 8919 ( Part II )-1978 ' Specification 
for adjustable adaptors for tools with self-holding taper shanks: Part II Long adaptors ' and IS : 8919 
( Part lll)-1978. ' Specification for adjustable adaptors for tools with self-holding taper shanks: Part III 
Extra long adaptors ' respectively used in multi-spindle machines* Typical applications of spindle 
noses are given in Appendix A.

*For nominal diameter d from 8 to 12 mm, diameter d 1 depends on the design requirements, the values given are for 
information only and for nominal diameter d from 16 to 48 mm, the tolerance on o\ is f7, if quick change adaptors are used. 
jThese values are for information only. 

Note 1 — Locking screw when tightened shall not protrude beyond the outside diameter of the spindle nose, 
therefore, screws may be reduced in iength if necessary. I his correction snail be carried out when the posiiion of 
the adjustable adaptor in the spindle nose corresponds with the maximum wear of the tool. 

Note 2 — The tolerances on dimensions without any specified tolerances shall be of grade 'medium' according 
to IS : 2102-1969 ' Allowable deviations for dimensions without specified tolerances ( first revision ) '.

EXPLANATORY NOTE 

In the preparation of this standard considerable assistance has been drawn from the following 
publications: 

ISO 2905-1974 Modular units for machine tool construction — spindle noses and adjustable 
adaptors for multispindle heads, issued by the International Organization for Standardi- 
zation. 

DIN 55058-1973 Bohrspindelkopfe fur Stellhulsen; AnschluBmaBe (Drilling spindle heads 
for adjustable heads for adjustable adaptors, mating dimension$)issued by Deutsches 
Institut fur Normung, 



Printed at Neelkamal Printers, Delhi, India
